title: Membership Desk Cross-Notice: Addition to a Custody Declaration for Circle Standing
content:
A further addition is made to a custody declaration under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes for customers whose membership in the Belrose Circle Membership Programme stands above Belrose Circle Gold, and its size depends on whether a concierge is named on that membership.

## The notice

Where the customer's membership stands above Belrose Circle Gold and a concierge is named on it, a further six percent (6 percent) is added. Where their membership stands above Belrose Circle Gold and no concierge is named on it, a further three percent (3 percent) is added. Otherwise nothing further is added for the customer's standing with the chain.

A membership stands above Belrose Circle Gold when its tier is Belrose Circle Platinum, Belrose Circle Black or the Belrose Circle Founders' Club. Whether a concierge is named is what the membership record shows.

## The grid

| Membership tier | Concierge named on the membership | Added |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Black or Founders' Club | yes | 6 percent |
| Platinum, Black or Founders' Club | no | 3 percent |
| Gold | either | nothing |
| Silver | either | nothing |
| Member | either | nothing |

## Readings on a figure of 20000 USD

- A Belrose Circle Black member with a named concierge: 21200.00 USD.
- A Belrose Circle Platinum member with none: 20600.00 USD.
- A Belrose Circle Gold member with a named concierge: 20000.00 USD; standing at Gold is not standing above it.
